title: Answer: life is open, and a living thing is read as a tower of selves

statements.text: Vibe has no separate account of what life is, and the question is open. Everything experiences, so life is not where experience begins. Living things are read as nested selves: cells make tissues, tissues organs and organs a body, and each level can pass the test for a self, a crowd of vibes that holds together, repairs itself and answers the world as a unit. Whether each level is also someone is open, and selves made of selves are partial in the ledger, measured only on older rules.
statements.scope: open. The tower of selves is measured only on older rules, not on the working rule

standing.reason: vibe's own answer to the questionnaire

sources.quote: a self is a crowd that acts as one: it holds together, it repairs itself, and it answers the world as a unit.
Whether each level is also someone is an open question.
